_comment: D-108, WP-3b.3c (§3.2.4). The bounded set of checks allowed to report `uninspectable` because they need a metadata source that is absent — the five T3 backend checks. Each names the reason pattern its notes must match and the decision that admits it. g-uninspectable-budget proves every classA key is a real tier check, every decision exists, and the set never grows past `max`. There is no flag that turns a backend-dependent check into a pass; this only bounds how many may be knowingly pushed.
